en.headline: Claire Liu wins Hong Kong Tennis Open for first WTA title
en.dek: American Claire Liu defeated Philippine rising star Alexandra Eala 6-3, 6-0 in the final at Victoria Park on Sunday, claiming her maiden WTA 250 title in one hour and 33 minutes.
body: Claire Liu of the United States claimed her first WTA Tour title on Sunday by beating Alexandra Eala of the Philippines 6-3, 6-0 in the final of the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium.

The 26-year-old Liu, ranked outside the top 100, needed just 1 hour and 33 minutes to complete the straight-sets victory. It was her second career final and her first title after five matches without dropping a set in Hong Kong.
Eala, the higher-ranked player and a rising star, reached the final after a rain-affected semi-final. The tournament is a WTA 250 event held on outdoor hard courts as part of the Asian swing.

zh.headline: 美國劉婧文擊敗伊雅娜 奪香港網球公開賽冠軍
zh.dek: 周日維多利亞公園決賽，美國球手劉婧文以6-3、6-0直落兩盤擊敗菲律賓新星伊雅娜，首奪WTA巡迴賽冠軍，比賽歷時1小時33分。
body: 美國球手劉婧文周日在維多利亞公園網球主場館舉行的保誠香港網球公開賽決賽中，以6-3、6-0直落兩盤擊敗菲律賓球手伊雅娜，奪得個人首個WTA巡迴賽冠軍。
26歲的劉婧文世界排名在100名以外，這是她職業生涯第二場決賽，也是她在香港五場比賽未失一盤後的首冠，整場比賽僅用時1小時33分鐘。
伊雅娜作為排名較高的新星，在受雨影響的半決賽後晉級決賽。這項WTA 250級賽事在硬地舉行，屬亞洲巡迴的一部分。
